recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore the removed VSD-aligned profile or impose the profile-specific identifier.system restriction on base ValueSet in current FHIR core; future fixes to migrated profile definitions should be handled in CRMI/profile-maintenance unless a new core tracker reverses FHIR-37923 and FHIR-37959.
issue_request: FHIR-26549 asked, as part of the VSD project, for ValueSet.identifier alignment with a globally unique Value Set Identifier. The final Published/Persuasive resolution said the VSD Profile would restrict ValueSet.identifier.system to OID, RUID, UUID, or URI, and the Jira comments clarified that this applied to the VSD-compliant profile rather than the base FHIR Core ValueSet resource.
initial_application: The seed was first listed in the broad VSD Profile commit 9fca6ca36f, which was reverted by 5161923416 and reapplied as 054eabf311. The actual seed-specific identifier.system restriction appears in git commit 633035c38a under the VSD-aligned ValueSet profile added for FHIR-30099, where ValueSet.identifier had a comment and constraint restricting Identifier.system to OID, RUID, UUID, or URI.
additional_context: Later final decisions changed the current source target. FHIR-37923 removed the VSD Aligned ValueSet profile from core, and FHIR-37959 later removed the remaining shareable/publishable/computable/executable terminology-resource profile family from current FHIR core for CRMI maintenance with canonical URLs unchanged. Existing combined-branch audit commits already cover FHIR-30099, FHIR-31395, FHIR-37923, FHIR-37959, and FHIR-36015.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current source/fhir.ini keeps ValueSet active as a base resource but has no active ValueSet VSD/shareable profile entry; source/valueset/implementationguide-ValueSet-core.xml has an empty definition; and the base ValueSet.identifier text remains a business identifier distinct from the canonical ValueSet.url. Adding the VSD restriction to base ValueSet would over-apply the Jira decision.
